evd_title: MARG-S outperformed all baselines by 6.1 recall points in automated evaluation on ARIES corpus
finding: MARG-S outperformed all baselines by 6.1 recall points in automated evaluation on ARIES corpus
P: 30 papers from ARIES corpus with real reviewer comments
I: MARG-S multi-agent reviewer (gpt-4-0613); GPT-4 as alignment judge
C: SARG-B, SARG-TP, MARG-TP, LiZCa, MARG-S ablations, human reviewers
O: Recall: MARG-S 15.84 vs SARG-TP 10.62, LiZCa 9.67, human 9.42; precision MARG-S 4.41 vs LiZCa 9.96, human 12.00
